info.syllabusName: Human Anatomy the artist_Giải phẫu tạo hình
info.description:
The course equips students with basic knowledges of structure, human body proportions and practice drawing as well as human drawing. This is a foundation course for speedy drawing and animated design.

Students will study the structure of the body's anatomy, then apply the gained knowledge to perform the drawing on human model. Each human anatomy and drawing study lasts for six slots and is performed in the classroom, under the guidance of the instructor. Anatomical research, student will have to carry at home on basis of the model drawing lesson on the class. The final class of the sixth slot will be scored. Lecturers and students make a mutual assessment, lecturer gives final score and will be counted as the credit mark.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook and references in advance

- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

- Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course.

materials.materialDescription: Figure drawing for all it's worth
materials.author: Andrew Loomis

clos.loDetails: Memorize the structure and muscles of the Human Body and know how to draw the proportion of The Head, The Shoulder and Arm, The Leg and Feet, The Torso.
Apply the knowledge that learned from The Human Portrait Practice to creat the human portrait and the facial expressions.
Analyze the Human in Action, then apply that learned skill to the practice of drawing human in action.
Explain the bones and muscles structure that lie beneath the skin. Analize the structure of the human body that lie beneath the clothes.
Have a positive attitude and a professional working style.
